method: Every active word is compared to NAVER's official JLPT catalog by written form + reading. Unmatched/ambiguous/mismatched rows are live-searched in NAVER Japanese Dictionary. Fail only on confirmed level mismatch, missing/broken example, missing TTS, or DB mismatch. Catalog-absent する-forms, counters, homographs, unconfirmed catalog mismatches, and JMdict derived-form flags are a review queue, not a release failure.
